title: Colore
subtitle: Coloured Table-Top Basins
intro: Colour is a language. Each shade in the Colore collection speaks to a different sensibility, from the quiet confidence of Nero to the serene calm of Avorio. Available in glossy and matte finishes, each basin is crafted from high-grade ceramic with colour fired into the glaze — ensuring permanence that matches its beauty.

items.name: Giada
items.description: A whisper of antique jade. Giada carries the calm of old porcelain, its glossy green shifting from soft mint to deep sea as the light moves through the day.

items.name: Menta
items.description: Matte and quiet as crushed sage leaves, Menta softens a room without ever raising its voice — a powdery green at home in morning light and evening shadow alike.

items.name: Ottanio
items.description: Deep as still water at dusk, Ottanio holds a teal that is equal parts blue and green. Its matte body drinks the light rather than returning it: grounded, composed, oceanic.

items.name: Petrolio
items.description: Petrolio glistens like deep water under lamplight — a saturated petrol-teal that turns near-black in shadow and luminous where the light lands. Dramatic, jewel-like, unmistakably modern.

items.name: Argilla
items.description: Warm as fired earth and burnished copper, Argilla glows against stone and greenery — a glossy terracotta tone that brings sunlit warmth to the form. Earthy, rich, quietly opulent.

items.name: Nero
items.description: Pure glossy black with the depth of polished obsidian. Nero reflects its surroundings like dark water, turning the basin into a study in restraint — bold, graphic, endlessly elegant.

items.name: Grigio
items.description: A cool, contemplative grey brushed with the faintest blue. Grigio mutes reflection into a calm, stone-like stillness — the neutral that anchors a room without disappearing into it.

items.name: Ardesia
items.description: Slate-blue and softly glossy, Ardesia recalls wet stone after rain. The finish lifts its muted blue into something quietly luminous — cool and architectural against warm marble.

items.name: Avorio
items.description: Soft as unbleached linen, Avorio is ivory without the cold. Its matte warmth flatters marble and brass alike — a quiet cream that reads as understated luxury, never plain white.
